project.name: osgi/runtime/scenario-probe
project.description: The HOST bundle of the testkit's own non-regression guard: a pure POJO (Vault) carrying a package-private member, with ZERO test dependencies — it does not know jGiven exists. It stands in for a real host bundle like doctor-core. Its sibling -test fragment (scenario-probe-test) is the template a real host copies: same classloader, same package, so the fragment reads the package-private member WHITE-BOX, and the jGiven imports the scenarios need are contributed by the fragment, not declared here.
